title: What happens with one prompt
heading: One prompt, one polished plan
caption: It looks finished. Look closer.
prompt: Plan your company's next summer party: 200 employees across five offices in Europe.
traitsLabel: What each trait left in the plan

probabilistic.why: Ask again, get a different answer.
probabilistic.produced: “Where should we hold it?” Lisbon. New chat, same question: Berlin.

relentless.why: One prompt, pages back in seconds, all to check.

confident.why: Fills your gaps with guesses, stated as facts.

every-word-billed.why: Each follow-up re-sends the whole chat.

callout: Hard to review. You are likely to throw it away and do it yourself.

one-prompt-in.title: One prompt in
one-prompt-in.script: So what happens if you do it all in one chat, with one short prompt: plan your company's next summer party, 200 employees across five offices in Europe? You get one long answer. A polished one. Look closer.

probabilistic.title: Probabilistic
probabilistic.script: They're probabilistic: ask where to hold it, and the answer is Lisbon. Open a new chat, ask the same question, and it's Berlin.

relentless.title: Relentless
relentless.script: They're relentless: one short prompt, and nine pages come back in seconds, venues, menus, even a forty-song playlist, and you have to check every line.

informed.title: Informed
informed.script: They're informed: they know every kind of party, just not yours. They suggest a rooftop club with a DJ until two, and nobody told them last year's party was too loud to talk.

confident.title: Confident
confident.script: They're confident: you never named a budget, so they picked one, 250 euros per head, and planned everything around it as if it were a fact.

every-word-billed.title: Every word billed
every-word-billed.script: And they bill every word: by your sixth follow-up, each message sends the whole chat again, all nine pages, read again and billed again.

you-saw-the-ai.title: You saw the AI
you-saw-the-ai.script: You've probably noticed: behind every trait, you already saw the AI. But let's stay in the thought experiment. If this were a human freelancer with these five traits, how would you onboard them for a complex task like this?

the-mental-model.title: The mental model
the-mental-model.script: That's the mental model I want to give you. As we go on, you'll see an AI agent behaves, weirdly, in many ways like this brilliant freelancer with amnesia. And your job is to onboard and manage them, so they deliver a result you can work with.
